Version C feels most natural to me. The explicit “Mark as read” and “Move back to To read” wording removes any guesswork, especially compared with a circle or a status tag that may not look clickable.

“All / To read / Finished” are clear names, and the counts are useful. The filter gives me exactly the focused view I wanted, and I like that changing status simply moves the bookmark rather than deleting it.

The slight dimming is helpful in the combined “All” view because it keeps attention on unread items. In the “Finished” view, though, I’d show those cards normally so the entire view doesn’t look faded.
